unit_rules.name: The Mechanic
unit_rules.text: While a +Leader+, models in the unit have !Feel No Pain 5+!. In addition, ranged weapons equipped by models in the unit have +[Sustained Hits 1]+.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Mechanic
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit and not a +Leader+, this model has +Lone Operative+.
